E-BOOKS

IFM library provides access to quality e-books from subscribed as well as open access databases. The availability of e-books promotes and supports transition to virtual learning that the Institute aims to embrace.

Browse

ONLINE PUBLIC ACCESS CATALOGUE (OPAC)

Use the library's Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) to navigate through the physical holdings of the library. Generally the library maintains over 30,000 volumes of print books which support the core functions of the Institute

Browse

E-DIGITAL REPOSITORY

Welcome to the Institute of Finance Management (IFM) digital repository. The aim of this digital repository is to collect, preserve, and distribute scholarly output generated by the faculty, students, and research scholars in the course of discharging the core functions of the Institute which are teaching, research and consultancy.
